method: Every live signal from every sleeve is scored out of 100. Up to 60 points come from how strong the sleeve's measured edge is (the cautious end of its research range, shrunk for small samples and weighted by how well it has been confirmed). A single empirical-Bayes estimate across sleeves is computed alongside and shown in each setup's breakdown, but not yet used for the score. Since Oct 15, 2026 'proven live' needs a test (t of at least 2 on 30 or more non-overlapping trades) and 'confirmed on fresh data' needs t of at least 3. Up to 20 come from measured extras: being in the top tenth by 6-month gain (withheld when SPY's 24-month return is negative, a panic state where momentum crashes concentrate) and a calibrated research boost. Up to 15 come from the setting: a down day for the market, not stretched far above the 50-day average, above its 3-month low. Other strategies agreeing is shown but never adds points. Each warning drops a setup one tier and is named on the card. A needs a score of 75 and evidence confirmed on fresh data; B needs 55. When nothing reaches B, the desk abstains: no picks yet during the session, and after the close that means it sat out the day. Stock size and trading volume are never used to filter. The Chart read on each setup page is context only: it can add a warning or one named demotion, never points. Sources: the desk's TA deep-dive brief (research/ta_deep_dive/BRIEF.md, Oct 15, 2026) and the Grand Synthesis canon. Paper trading, not advice.
Score calibration: dormant until each tier has 30 resolved picks (A 0, B 0 so far); no probability is shown before then.

patterns.note: Every chart read is logged before outcomes. A pattern's average 20-session result vs SPY appears only after 30 scored cases; until then patterns are judgment, not proven edge, and never add points.

divergences.note: Every divergence is logged on the day it is on the chart, before outcomes. Its average 20-session result vs SPY in the direction it points appears only after 30 scored cases; until then divergences are context only and never add points.

desk_reads.note: Every Desk read is logged daily before outcomes and scored against SPY at 5, 20, 60 sessions. Results per gut call appear after 30 resolved reads in that bucket; calibration switches on when every bucket has 30 at 20 sessions. Until it proves out, the Desk read adds no points.

track_record.note: Each trading morning the top picks are frozen in a tamper-evident log and scored after 5, 20 and 60 trading days against SPY and against all of that day's candidates. Nothing gets re-weighted until each tier has at least 30 scored picks.

explain.edge_points: Edge points = 60 x this sleeve's rank among all sleeves on the cautious end of its 95% range per 20 trading days, shrunk for small samples and weighted by evidence tier (confirmed on fresh data 0.75, out of sample 0.5, thin 0.25, none 0).
explain.calibrated: Calibrated means the sleeve's own research tested which signal features went with better or worse results and kept only patterns that held up out of sample. A calibrated boost adds 4 points; an avoid pattern removes 4 and is listed as a warning.
explain.held_out: Held out: tested on data the rule was not built on. Fresh: re-tested on newer data that did not exist when it was found.
